goal: Make p2p message handling easier to navigate and review for maintainers
Break up a monolithic thousand-line message processing function into dedicated helper functions
agreement: Strong support for improving encapsulation and code navigation in message processing
Verified as a pure move-only refactoring with thread safety preserved (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds)
Supports easier navigation and consistency with previous extractions (stickies-v, maflcko, theStack)
Resolved concern that helper functions add caller ambiguity compared to a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal code cleanup with no effect on network behavior
Offers minor maintenance benefits to developers working on message processing
Does not resolve bugs, enhance network performance, or retire security hazards
